summary: Reset positions deletes my saved arrangement without asking first.
observedBehavior: When I choose Reset positions, the saved browser-local arrangement is cleared immediately.
expectedBehavior: When I choose Reset positions, ask me before deleting the saved arrangement so I can cancel a destructive reset.
reproductionSteps: Open the saved-layout system map for the supported baseline.
Move a box and let the arrangement be saved.
Observe that the saved arrangement is cleared without a confirmation step.
evidence: review-workbench-v13/src/main.jsx implements immediate Reset positions behavior.
The saved-layout implementation adapter supports confirm-before-reset as a valid alternative.
